confirm.description: Sign in the kiosk of {name} to Home Assistant automatically? A Home Assistant user "WallView" (no administrator rights, local network only) is created and the panel shows its dashboards without typing a password. The panel itself is a device of the ESPHome integration; add it there as well, the sign-in is sent once both are set up. This integration adds no device of its own. To sign the kiosk in again later, press "Sign in again" on the panel's ESPHome device.

abort.discovery_only: WallView panels are discovered automatically on the local network.
abort.not_wallview: This device is not a WallView panel.

esphome_missing.description: Kiosk sign-in for {name} is approved, but the panel is not set up in the ESPHome integration yet. Add the discovered panel in ESPHome; the kiosk is signed in as soon as it is connected.
